text:
elena: quick follow-up from today's security segment — pulling together answers re: SOC2 evidence, VPC options, audit-log exports, and KMS/BYOK rotation. drop questions here and we'll answer.

dan: short answers first: audit logs export locations differ by deployment: hosted -> s3://redwood-logs/audit/, private -> exported to your customer-s3 by default. retention default = 90d. to change to 180/365 submit a compliance request (see priya).

priya: to request extended retention or SOC2 evidence bundle, open the compliance-request form (bit.ly/rwd-compliance). include: project name, account id, desired retention, and `evidence_owner` contact. we need 72h lead time for manual bundles. :calendar:

oscar: VPC clarification: we support VPC Interface Endpoints (recommended) and AWS PrivateLink for hosted integrations. VPC peering is not recommended for production traffic due to routing complexity and cross-account blast radius. if you're evaluating, ping eng-platform for an architecture check.

jen: how do teams get the audit exports path and perms? do they need a ticket?

dan: yes — for Private deployments we create an export role in your account. send a ticket with the cluster id + S3 bucket arn. example export path: `s3://customer-exports/<org>-audit/`

elena: KMS/BYOK: baseline: we recommend key rotation every 90 days for BYOK. we support automatic rotation for CMKs when customer enables rotation in KMS. if you need HSM/BYOK with external rotation, we have a workflow — includes supplying key material and rotation schedule. reach out to security for onboarding.

audit-bot: Created ticket COMP-2026 to track outstanding evidence requests mentioned in this thread.

priya: note on SOC2 evidence: we provide access to the evidence pack and the relevant control mappings. product teams must map their features to control owners and provide sample prompts/test runs for privacy controls.

oscar: operational note — if you rely on prefix/KV caching, include that in your evidence request so we can capture relevant traces.

jen: can we get a one-pager checklist for product and eng teams?

dan: yes. i'll drop a checklist in #eng-docs by EOD. it will include: request template, s3 perms template, rotation checklist, and FAQ.

elena: adding office hours: security + eng-platform will host an office hour next Tue 11am PT for SOC2/BYOK/VPC questions. sign-up link: https://meet.redwood.ai/soc2-officehours. if you can't make it, post questions here and we'll answer or attach to the recording.

jen: thanks — will forward to product leads. :thumbsup:

elena: cool — we'll follow up with slides + runbook link after office hours. closing the loop for now. if anything urgent, @dan or @priya are the owners.
